slices.red: A segmented reviewer attempt has no frozen schema-valid byte budget for fixed prompt, capsule, packet, tool results, candidate output, or required headroom.
slices.green: The parent freezes bootstrap-context-budget.v1 before launch, computes every declared byte budget, rejects over-budget input before Popen, and binds budget revision to request, receipt, cache, and final validation.
slices.regression: Run the targeted context-budget tests, complete Bootstrap regression suite, whole-directory validation, and Skill validation.

slices.red: A segmented child still needs raw delegated authority text or can infer authority from the complete repository control-plane closure.
slices.green: The parent compiles a deterministic role-specific bootstrap-review-policy-capsule.v1 from the fully validated authority, binds its hash into the request and receipt, and the child receives capsule-only authority.
slices.regression: Run capsule schema/producer/consumer tests and all Bootstrap regression checks.

slices.red: A child can use ambient repository or full-run paths to expand beyond its assigned segment and produce tool output outside the declared packet.
slices.green: The parent materializes bootstrap-review-packet.v1, starts the child outside the repository Git root with only packet/capsule/handshake/schema inputs, and rejects packet-external access before formal publication.
slices.regression: Run fake-child isolation, packet schema, path containment, and complete Bootstrap regression tests.

slices.red: Acceptance and Bootstrap callers can expose raw stdout, manifests, and validator output instead of a fixed-size lifecycle/result projection.
slices.green: Bootstrap and Acceptance publish bootstrap-parent-projection.v1 only for parent-facing status; raw process material remains attempt evidence and final import consumes the validation envelope by path/hash.
slices.regression: Run Acceptance integration/projection tests, Bootstrap regression suite, whole-directory validation, and Skill validation.

slices.red: The control plane has no deterministic two-times-scope fixture proving packet, capsule, tool, candidate, projection, and retry bounds without model launch.
slices.green: A synthetic two-times-current-scope fixture passes all boundedness and no-unchanged-retry predicates; a real canary is a separate fresh-run operator action and never acceptance authority.
slices.regression: Run deterministic stress and all registered Bootstrap/Acceptance regression checks.
